atoms.text: Sammy is on his way home from school. First, he passes all the school buses parked in a row and waves at some of his friends hanging out of the windows. He grabs his bike and helmet and climbs on, looks both ways and starts riding on the pavement.
atoms.sound: ssml: Sammy Rides. <break time='500ms'/> Sammy is on his way home from school. First, he passes all the school buses parked in a row and waves at some of his friends hanging out of the windows. He grabs his bike and helmet and climbs on, looks both ways, and starts riding on the pavement.

atoms.text: His next stop is the neighbourhood football pitch. He pedals hard, wanting to get there early to find a safe place to lock up his bike. He practices with his team. Sammy loves playing football and trying to score goals. There’s a game on Saturday, and Sammy wants to be as ready as he can.
Next, Sammy stops by the sweetshop and uses his leftover lunch money to buy a chocolate bar. Shh! don’t tell his mum!
atoms.sound: ssml: Next, Sammy stops by the sweetshop and uses his leftover lunch money to buy a chocolate bar. Shh! don’t tell his mum!

atoms.text: Finally, Sammy is home. He pulls out his keys and lets himself into his building. He takes the stairs up to the fourth floor and happily breathes in the delicious smell of a home-cooked dinner.
